title: Ishengero ryazimiye
intro: Uhagaze imbere y’ijwi ry’umuryango inkuru yawo yanditswe mu mipfunda. Abo bantu bumvise ihamagarwa, bahitamwo gutera umugongo, maze bahura n’ingaruka zahinduye isi. None abo ni bande, kandi isi yabo yabaye iki?
clues: Twarabayeho kera cane, haza intumwa ivuye muri twebwe.
Twarasenga ibigirwamana bitanu kandi twanka kubiheba.
Twaratwengeye iyo ntumwa, tuyirega ko yazimiye.
Twasavye ko azana igihano nimba ari umunyakuri.
Twarabonye ijuru risuka imvura n’isi isuka amasoko.
Twaraduze tuja mu misozi miremire kugira ngo duhunge, ariko imiraba iradufata.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Twese twarimbutse kiretse abemera bari kumwe na Nuh .

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
